basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Scientist II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Mechanical Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has advertised one Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) post in the ICMR-sponsored project PRAGATICAR (Project Code – R/CIH), with Prof./Dr. Suman Chakraborty as PI/Co-PI. The consolidated compensation is up to ₹67,000 per month for 12 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. The essential qualification is a PG degree with 3 years' experience, or a PhD. Applications are online under Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/CIH/2026/102, and the last date is 9 December 2026.

age_limit.details: For the discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

how_to_apply: The notice invites applications online for Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/CIH/2026/102, and the last date of application is 9 December 2026. The notice does not print the web address of the application form or any further application steps.

The application fee is printed as ₹0 for all categories. The notice still gives a bank account for fee deposit through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking, and says the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form:
Bank name: State Bank of India (00202)
Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302
Name of bank account: IIT SRIC-OM Account

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) posts are advertised by IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: One post of Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) is advertised under Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/CIH/2026/102.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the post?
faq.answer: A PG degree, including an integrated PG degree, in a relevant subject with 3 years' post-qualification experience, or a PhD. For Engineering/IT/CS, a 4-year graduate degree plus 3 years' post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years, as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to ₹67,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is printed as ₹0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project, with a tenure of 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Which project is the post in?
faq.answer: The post is in the ICMR-sponsored project PRAGATICAR (Project Code – R/CIH) in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, with Prof./Dr. Suman Chakraborty as PI/Co-PI.

faq.question: Q10. Will every candidate who meets the qualification be called for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
